reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 06 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: External-03 still has three separate gray blobs in each of the two upper note rows, six total. The requirement and source layout are exactly two compact gray-mark groups per row. Reduce each row to two source-scale groups without adding a third row or lower-left dash.
entries.positive_observation: There are exactly two upper rows, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The high bald crown, short gray-brown side hair, dark eyebrows and rectangular spectacles remain. The face has one closed mouth and no added moustache or beard. The slight viewer-left pose, red/gold collar patches, pale ribbon and one small silver-toned pendant remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The three-versus-two gray-blob count in each row is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Precise spectacle-rim geometry, tiny pendant/ribbon details and note glyph identity are not fully readable at 65x67. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the native crop unambiguously shows three blobs per row rather than the required two.
